name: smartscope
desc: Free, open-source SSD and HDD health checker for Windows — read SMART data and catch failing drives early. 100 MB portable, no ads, MIT.
features: ✅ **Plain-language verdict** — 30+ SMART attributes become GOOD / CAUTION / BAD per drive, no hex tables to decode
✅ **NVMe, SATA and USB** — NVMe health log via storage protocol, SATA SMART via ATA pass-through, blocked USB bridges flagged
✅ **Temperature timeline** — per-minute logging for 90 days with tray alerts on threshold crossing (default 55 °C)
✅ **Failure early-warning** — weighted score from reallocated, pending sectors and wear leveling trends
✅ **Raw attribute drill-down** — raw, normalized and threshold values side by side for every attribute
✅ **CSV and JSON export** — one click dumps all drive snapshots for spreadsheets or fleet scripts
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — no service, no installer, offline; MIT with CI-built SHA-256 releases
compare: | Feature | **smartscope** | CrystalDiskInfo | Hard Disk Sentinel | HD Tune Pro |
| Plain-language health verdict | **Yes** | Partial | Partial | No |
| Temperature history and alerts | **90 days** | No | Yes | No |
| Raw SMART drill-down | **Yes** | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Zip | Installer | Installer |
faqQ: how to check SSD health on Windows?
faqA: SMART data exists on every modern drive but Windows buries it, so people find problems after a crash, not before. smartscope reads the same data and translates it into a three-level verdict with a temperature history that shows drives trending hot or worn. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, no ads and fully offline with SHA-256 releases.
s1: Dark dashboard (#101214, emerald #34D399): drive cards left showing GOOD status and 38 °C, attribute table right with normalized bars.
s2: Attribute detail: reallocated-sector chart over 30 days, threshold markers, raw hex values in muted gray, export button.
s3: Alert settings: 55 °C threshold slider, tray notification toggle, CSV export path, list of USB bridges that block SMART.
